docs.body:
Shortest-arc interpolation in polar OKLCH coordinates.
 Endpoints and their difference in `[-540, 540]` retain their exact
 single-turn arithmetic and signed half-turn ties. Other finite endpoints use equivalent
 near-zero hue representatives, avoiding overflow and cancellation.
